description: Overview of key public educational institutions in the Province of Aklan, including the provincial state university.
steps: Aklan State University (ASU) — Main Campus, Banga, Aklan (State University — Free tuition under RA 10931)
Public elementary and secondary schools in all 17 municipalities (under DepEd Aklan Division)
For enrollment inquiries, contact your nearest municipal DepEd Division or school registrar.

faqs.question: When does enrollment start?
faqs.answer: Enrollment typically begins in June–July. Follow the official DepEd Aklan Division announcements.

faqs.question: Is tuition free at Aklan State University?
faqs.answer: Yes. Under RA 10931, tuition is free at all State Universities and Colleges (SUCs), including ASU. Only miscellaneous fees may apply.

description: Scholarship and educational assistance programs available to Aklan residents, administered through the Provincial Social Welfare and Development Office (PSWDO) and partner agencies.
steps: Monitor the official Provincial Government of Aklan website and Facebook page (facebook.com/aklanIMAD) for scholarship announcements.
Submit your application at the PSWDO or Governor's Office during the application period.
Attend screening/interview and orientation if shortlisted.
requirements: Barangay Certificate of Residency (from your barangay in Aklan)
Income documents: parents' ITR or Certificate of Non-Filing / indigency certificate

quickInfo.whoCanApply: Aklan residents who are incoming or current college students

sources.name: Provincial Social Welfare and Development Office (PSWDO) — (036) 272-7000 local 3200

service: Special Program for Employment of Students (SPES)
description: DOLE's SPES program allows poor but deserving students and out-of-school youth (15–30 years old) to work during school breaks. Coordinated locally by PESO Aklan.
steps: Follow PESO Aklan announcements on the Provincial Government website and Facebook page for SPES application windows.
Prepare required documents (ID, school records, indigency/income proof).
Submit application at the PESO office or as directed in the announcement.
Attend orientation when shortlisted and complete the employment period.

quickInfo.whoCanApply: Students and out-of-school youth aged 15–30 from Aklan
